summary: The matting itself, separated from the window so it is callable and testable without a GUI.
overview: The actual background-removal pass behind BackgroundMatteWindow, kept as a plain class with an Options struct so it can be driven from your own editor script or a test rather than only from the window.
useCases: Running the same matte from your own import pipeline instead of by hand.
Trying threshold settings on one image before committing to a batch.

gotchas.title: Editor-only by placement
gotchas.body: It lives in an Editor/ folder, so it is not available at runtime. This project has no .asmdef files, which means folder placement is the only thing separating editor from runtime code.
